messages:
Priya (sec-eng): Quick heads-up — scheduling a pen-test retest dry run next week for the RBAC + KMS changes. Need to validate audit proofs and ephemeral role handoff. :calendar:
Evan (infra): Which envs are we running the dry run against? staging only or staging+preprod?
Priya (sec-eng): staging + preprod. We want to exercise KMS proxy, ephemeral creds, and log export pipeline. Not hitting prod.
Alex (platform): OK. For RBAC we'll apply the change in a toggled fashion (feature-flag rollout). Plan: 10-min canary, then full in the window if no blockers.
Sam (oncall): What time windows? I can cover both days but prefer low-traffic windows (US morning). Also need a rollback playbook in the thread.
Priya (sec-eng): Propose Tue/Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Rollback: revert toggle + revoke ephemeral roles and rotate the staging KMS key alias to previous snapshot. Simple steps in runbook.
Marta (audits): For evidence I need: (1) KMS access logs for key alias used, (2) Cloud audit logs for IAM role assumption, (3) TLS session logs for the proxy. Can you list exact queries we should run after the run?
Evan (infra): Sample AWS CloudTrail query:
```
-- CloudTrail lookup by eventName
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-02T00:00:00Z
```
And KMS:
```
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/kms/key-usage --start-time 1710000000000 --end-time 1710003600000 --filter-pattern "KeyId=alias/redwood-staging-kms"
```
Priya (sec-eng): Also include the ephemeral-role session tags in the filter (sessionName, requestor). We'll drop a sample tag in the test: sessionTag=test-retest-<ts>.
Alex (platform): RBAC change snippet (Terraform):
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "retest_attach" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.retest_role.name
  policy_arn = var.retest_policy_arn
}
```
Alex (platform): We'll set role DurationSeconds=7200 for the dry run — matches oncall TTL.
Sam (oncall): TTL=7200 sounds good. I'll supervise and run the rollback if we see elevated error rates >5% or latencies >2s for the /infer route.
Marta (audits): For log sampling, please export a zipped bundle to the evidence bucket with path: s3://redwood-evidence/retests/4887654321/ and include a checksums.txt. I need SHA256 hashes.
Priya (sec-eng): Good. We'll push a pre-run checklist to the runbook page and tag @Sam and @Marta when ready.
Evan (infra): Deploy-bot schedule request follows.
deploy-bot: scheduled-job created by Evan: retest-dryrun-rbac-kms 2026-03-09T02:30:00Z -> 2026-03-09T04:30:00Z (staging,preprod). JobID: job-488765-dryrun
Priya (sec-eng): Thanks. One more ask: during the run please do not delete any CloudTrail events for 30 days. Keep retention extras enabled for that window.
Evan (infra): Will set temporary retention override +90 days for the staging trail and tag it for audit.
Alex (platform): After the run I'll run the quality smoke: 50 synthetic requests through the inference path and capture token-level latencies. Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -s | jq .time_ms
```
Sam (oncall): I'll be on the bridge 15 mins before start. Ping me in #eng-oncall and DM if rollback needed. :phone:
Marta (audits): I'll validate proofs within 48 hours and confirm retest acceptance.
Priya (sec-eng): Perfect. I'll update runbook and drop a final sign-off message 24h before. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
